# PR #109 (T-065, zod 4) review

Fresh reviewer without the implementer's context, read-only. `bun run check` passed (43 files / 488 tests); `bun audit` 5 advisories, none for zod. Verdict: no blocking findings.

The reviewer ran zod 3.25.76 and 4.6.7 side by side on the same inputs: `z.guid()` = zod 3's `uuid()` (seed ids, uppercase, all-zero; refusals without hyphens, in braces, with a space); `z.email()` = zod 3's `email()` on 23 addresses (seznam.cz with `+`, Centrum.CZ uppercase, hyphen, `_`, `'`, subdomain, `.co.uk` accepted; double dot, edge dots, no TLD, spaces, Czech letters, IP literal, quoted local part refused); `.trim().min(1).max(500)`, `null` vs `undefined`, unknown keys, NaN/Infinity: identical. Only zod 4.6.7 is left in `bun.lock`; `@hookform/resolvers` accepts zod 4 and is unused; no `@lovable.dev/*` package needs zod; no zod code reaches the client bundle (`inputValidator` is stripped).
